articles.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces mounting political and economic pressure across India

articles.title: Gujarat Police Innovation Challenge 2026: Winning teams awarded ₹18 lakh; focus
articles.summary: The valedictory ceremony of the ‘Gujarat Police Innovation Challenge 2026’ (Sentinel Hackathon 2026) concluded at i-Hub in Ahmedabad , marking a significant milestone in the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and CCTV infrastructure for public safety. The two-day event, described as India’s largest AI-CCTV hackathon, saw enthusiastic participation from innovators, startups, and researchers nationwide.

articles.title: Geothermal energy talks in Houston back US-India technology transfer and pilot projects
articles.summary: Senior US energy executives and Indian diplomats held a closed-door roundtable in Houston to speed up cooperation on next-generation geothermal energy. The meeting explored technology transfer, joint pilot projects, and investment options. Participants aimed to use Houston’s expertise in drilling, subsurface engineering, and oilfield services to support India’s clean energy transition.
articles.title_hi: अमेरिका-भारत प्रौद्योगिकी हस्तांतरण और पायलट परियोजनाओं के समर्थन में ह्यूस्टन में भू-तापीय ऊर्जा वार्ता

articles.title_hinglish: amerika-bharata praudyogiki hastantarana aura payalata pariyojanaon ke samarthana men hyustana men bhu-tapiya oorja varta
articles.summary_hinglish: varishtha ameriki oorja adhikariyon aura bharatiya rajanayikon ne agali pidhaी ki bhu-tapiya oorja para sahayoga ko gati dene ke lie hyustana men eka banda kamare men golameja baithaka ki। baithaka men praudyogiki hastantaran, sanyukta payalata pariyojanaon aura nivesha vikalpon para vichara kiya gaya। pratibhagiyon ka lakshya bharata ke svachchha oorja parivartana ka samarthana karane ke lie driling, upasataha injiniyaringa aura tela kshetra sevaon men hyustana ki visheshajnyata ka upayoga karana tha।

articles.title: Delhi Police Crime Branch Takes Over Unauthorized Entry Case of CJP Leaders
articles.summary: The Delhi Police Crime Branch has taken over the unauthorized entry case involving Cockroach Janata Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Sourav Das. A Delhi court extended their judicial custody until October 21 after they allegedly trespassed into Jantar Mantar and violated peace bonds while demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner. The next hearing is scheduled for October 21.

articles.title: Manipur tense after violence: 4 killed in separate incidents; 3 CRPF personnel injured
articles.summary: Manipur Police has intensified security operations after three separate incidents between October 18 and 19 left four people dead and injured several others, including three CRPF personnel. The incidents included community clashes in Thoubal district following stone-pelting, an IED blast near Singjamei and firing by unidentified armed militants on Meitei villagers near Khongbal.

articles.summary: The Chief Minister recalled that the United States imposed an additional 25 per cent tariff on Indian goods in August 2025 over India's purchases of Russian crude, taking the total tariffs on many Indian exports to 50 per cent. “Modi Never Compromised,” Sarma wrote, arguing that the Opposition's allegations that the Prime Minister had yielded to American pressure were misplaced.

articles.title: Palma-Gumla highway route in Jharkhand is open now
articles.summary: The 63. 17-km Palma-Gumla stretch of National Highway 43 (NH-43) in Jharkhand has been opened to traffic, marking a step towards improving road connectivity and reducing travel time in the region, according to a Times of India (TOI) report. Officials from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) announced the development during an outreach visit on Thursday.

articles.title: "Monstrous Burial Of Dignity": Death Penalty In Nashik Child Rape-Murder Case
articles.summary: In a detailed order, Additional Sessions Judge KG Paldewar held that the coldness with which the victim's body was dumped shocked society's collective conscience, ruling that sympathy in any form would be misplaced in such a diabolic crime. It noted that the alternative punishment of life imprisonment was "unquestionably foreclosed" due to the total depravity demonstrated by the convict.

articles.title: Metro footfall halved on October 10 amid protest curbs

articles.title: Patnaik questions Odisha's silence over Andhra polls in disputed Kotia
articles.summary: Odisha and Andhra Pradesh have for decades claimed 21 of the 28 villages in Kotia gram panchayat. The dispute is before the Supreme Court, where a fresh suit filed by Odisha in January 2022 remains under consideration. Patnaik, the leader of the opposition in the Odisha Assembly, raised the issue in a letter to Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi.

articles.title: Jammu and Kashmir Bound Bus Attacked With Stones in Haryana After Dispute
articles.summary: A private bus traveling to Srinagar was attacked with stones in Haryana on October 17 after a parking dispute. Two local residents were arrested following the incident, which injured an elderly passenger and damaged several windows. Police stated the confrontation began over parking space and registered a case after receiving a formal complaint from a local dhaba manager.

articles.title: Mizoram Police seize ₹2.4 crore worth of suspected illegal goods
articles.summary: Aizawl, Oct 19: Mizoram Police have seized suspected illegally transported fertiliser, dry areca nuts, foreign cigarettes, liquor and methamphetamine in a series of operations across the state between October 12 and 18. articles.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee Detained During Bengaluru Election Protest
articles.summary: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by police in Gurugram on October 10 after joining a protest in Bengaluru. Organized by the Cockroach Janta Party, the demonstration demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral roll irregularities. The event highlights how social media creators are moving from digital commentary into physical political activism in India.

articles.title: U.S. Polo Assn Opens First New Identity Store in Puducherry

articles.title: Uttarakhand shops asked to display 'use-by' dates for sweets on display from Oct 26
articles.summary: The move aims to improve transparency about food freshness and help consumers make informed purchasing decisions. articles.title: Trump waives Russia sanctions, easing India’s energy concerns as US trade deal nears
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump waived key Russian sanctions which may enhance trade relations with India. articles.summary_hinglish: vastava men eka vishva stariya shahara eka aisi svasthya seva pranali ka hakadara hai jo sulabh, sasti, paradarshi aura dayalu ho। aspatalon ko kevala bimariyon ka ilaja nahin karana chahie, balki unhen marijon ke satha garim, sahanubhuti aura sammana ke satha vyavahara karana chahie। pratiksha samaya ko kama karan, paradarshi bilinga sunishchita karan, aapatakalina sevaon ko majabuta karan, svachchhata banae rakhan, doktara-rogi sanchara men sudhara karana aura naidanika ​​​​parikshanon aura davaon ko kiphayati banana samaya ki manga hai।

articles.title: Excess liquidity weighing on Indian equities, says Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman
articles.summary: Excess domestic liquidity in the equity market has contributed to the underperformance of stocks and could remain a challenge, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has said. In an exclusive interview with CNBC on Friday, on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok, Sitharaman said the easy availability of liquidity was encouraging investors to exit equity positions more readily.
articles.title_hi: वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण का कहना है कि अतिरिक्त तरलता का असर भारतीय इक्विटी पर पड़ रहा है
articles.summary_hi: वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण ने कहा है कि इक्विटी बाजार में अतिरिक्त घरेलू तरलता ने शेयरों के खराब प्रदर्शन में योगदान दिया है और यह एक चुनौती बनी रह सकती है। बैंकॉक में आईएमएफ-विश्व बैंक की बैठकों के मौके पर शुक्रवार को सीएनबीसी के साथ एक विशेष साक्षात्कार में, सीतारमण ने कहा कि तरलता की आसान उपलब्धता निवेशकों को इक्विटी पदों से अधिक आसानी से बाहर निकलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित कर रही है।
articles.title_hinglish: vitta mantri nirmala sitaramana ka kahana hai ki atirikta taralata ka asara bharatiya ikviti para pada raha hai
articles.summary_hinglish: vitta mantri nirmala sitaramana ne kaha hai ki ikviti bajara men atirikta gharelu taralata ne sheyaron ke kharaba pradarshana men yogadana diya hai aura yaha eka chunauti bani raha sakati hai। bainkoka men aaeeemaepha-vishva bainka ki baithakon ke mauke para shukravara ko sienabisi ke satha eka vishesha sakshatkara men, sitaramana ne kaha ki taralata ki aasana upalabdhata niveshakon ko ikviti padon se adhika aasani se bahara nikalane ke lie protsahita kara rahi hai।

articles.title: Kerala High Court refuses to stay State's reconstitution of Waqf Board
articles.summary: The Court examined whether the government had the authority to cancel the appointments of existing Waqf Board members and nominate new members in their place. It also considered whether the government's decision to replace the existing members was consistent with what it had earlier submitted before a division bench about filling only vacancies on the Board.
articles.title_hi: केरल उच्च न्यायालय ने राज्य के वक्फ बोर्ड के पुनर्गठन पर रोक लगाने से इनकार कर दिया
articles.summary_hi: कोर्ट ने जांच की कि क्या सरकार के पास मौजूदा वक्फ बोर्ड के सदस्यों की नियुक्तियों को रद्द करने और उनके स्थान पर नए सदस्यों को नामित करने का अधिकार है। इसमें इस बात पर भी विचार किया गया कि क्या मौजूदा सदस्यों को बदलने का सरकार का निर्णय बोर्ड में केवल रिक्तियों को भरने के बारे में एक खंडपीठ के समक्ष पहले प्रस्तुत किए गए निर्णय के अनुरूप था।
articles.title_hinglish: kerala uchcha nyayalaya ne rajya ke vakpha borda ke punargathana para roka lagane se inakara kara diya
articles.summary_hinglish: korta ne jancha ki ki kya sarakara ke pasa maujuda vakpha borda ke sadasyon ki niyuktiyon ko radda karane aura unake sthana para nae sadasyon ko namita karane ka adhikara hai। isamen isa bata para bhi vichara kiya gaya ki kya maujuda sadasyon ko badalane ka sarakara ka nirnaya borda men kevala riktiyon ko bharane ke bare men eka khandapitha ke samaksha pahale prastuta kie gae nirnaya ke anurupa tha।

articles.title: Evolve Green Targets 3 GW Renewable Energy Portfolio by 2030
articles.summary: Evolve Green Energies plans 3 GW of owned renewable assets by 2030, backed by structured debt and strategic equity. Chennai-based Evolve Green Energies, the flagship company of Evolve Energy Group, plans to build a 3 GW portfolio of owned renewable energy assets by 2030 as it expands into long-term clean power generation and asset ownership.
articles.title_hi: 2030 तक हरित लक्ष्य 3 गीगावॉट नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा पोर्टफोलियो विकसित करना
articles.summary_hi: इवॉल्व ग्रीन एनर्जीज़ ने संरचित ऋण और रणनीतिक इक्विटी द्वारा समर्थित, 2030 तक 3 गीगावॉट स्वामित्व वाली नवीकरणीय संपत्ति की योजना बनाई है। चेन्नई स्थित इवॉल्व ग्रीन एनर्जी, इवॉल्व एनर्जी ग्रुप की प्रमुख कंपनी, 2030 तक स्वामित्व वाली नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा परिसंपत्तियों का 3 गीगावॉट पोर्टफोलियो बनाने की योजना बना रही है क्योंकि यह दीर्घकालिक स्वच्छ बिजली उत्पादन और परिसंपत्ति स्वामित्व में विस्तार करती है।
articles.title_hinglish: 2030 taka harita lakshya 3 gigavota navikaraniya oorja portapholiyo vikasita karana
articles.summary_hinglish: ivolva grina enarjija ne sanrachita rina aura rananitika ikviti dvara samarthit, 2030 taka 3 gigavota svamitva vali navikaraniya sanpatti ki yojana banaee hai। chennaee sthita ivolva grina enarji, ivolva enarji grupa ki pramukha kanpani, 2030 taka svamitva vali navikaraniya oorja parisanpattiyon ka 3 gigavota portapholiyo banane ki yojana bana rahi hai kyonki yaha dirghakalika svachchha bijali utpadana aura parisanpatti svamitva men vistara karati hai।

articles.title: No Nehru, Gandhi or Yadav: Owaisi wants young Muslims to step up for UP
articles.summary: The AIMIM chief's remarks at an event in Rampur come as political activity gathers pace ahead of the high-stakes 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, with the party eyeing around 200 seats. Owaisi's visit has drawn attention to AIMIM's potential impact on the state's electoral calculations, with the party expected to focus primarily on constituencies with a sizeable Muslim population.
articles.title_hi: कोई नेहरू, गांधी या यादव नहीं: ओवैसी चाहते हैं कि युवा मुसलमान यूपी के लिए आगे आएं
articles.summary_hi: रामपुर में एक कार्यक्रम में एआईएमआईएम प्रमुख की टिप्पणी तब आई है जब 2027 के उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनावों से पहले राजनीतिक गतिविधियां तेज हो गई हैं, जिसमें पार्टी की नजर लगभग 200 सीटों पर है। ओवैसी की यात्रा ने राज्य की चुनावी गणना पर एआईएमआईएम के संभावित प्रभाव की ओर ध्यान आकर्षित किया है, पार्टी को मुख्य रूप से बड़ी मुस्लिम आबादी वाले निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने की उम्मीद है।
articles.title_hinglish: koee neharu, gandhi ya yadava nahin: ovaisi chahate hain ki yuva musalamana yupi ke lie aage aaen
articles.summary_hinglish: ramapura men eka karyakrama men eaaeeemaaaeeema pramukha ki tippani taba aaee hai jaba 2027 ke uttara pradesha vidhanasabha chunavon se pahale rajanitika gatividhiyan teja ho gaee hain, jisamen parti ki najara lagabhaga 200 siton para hai। ovaisi ki yatra ne rajya ki chunavi ganana para eaaeeemaaaeeema ke sanbhavita prabhava ki ora dhyana aakarshita kiya hai, parti ko mukhya rupa se badaी muslima aabadi vale nirvachana kshetron para dhyana kendrita karane ki ummida hai।

articles.title: China’s Solar Tech Export Curbs: What It Means for India
articles.summary: China will still sell India solar panels, but it now wants to guard the recipe for making them. Here’s what its new export curbs mean for India’s solar cell shortage, the companies racing to expand, and who else India can turn to. Imagine the best biryani shop in your neighbourhood.

articles.summary_hi: चीन अब भी भारत को सोलर पैनल बेचेगा, लेकिन अब वह इन्हें बनाने की विधि पर नजर रखना चाहता है। यहां बताया गया है कि भारत में सौर सेल की कमी, विस्तार करने की होड़ में लगी कंपनियों और भारत किसकी ओर रुख कर सकता है, के लिए इसके नए निर्यात प्रतिबंधों का क्या मतलब है। अपने पड़ोस में सबसे अच्छी बिरयानी की दुकान की कल्पना करें।
articles.title_hinglish: china ka solara teka niryata pratibandh: bharata ke lie isaka kya matalaba hai
articles.summary_hinglish: china aba bhi bharata ko solara painala becheg, lekina aba vaha inhen banane ki vidhi para najara rakhana chahata hai। yahan bataya gaya hai ki bharata men saura sela ki kami, vistara karane ki hoda men lagi kanpaniyon aura bharata kisaki ora rukha kara sakata hai, ke lie isake nae niryata pratibandhon ka kya matalaba hai। apane padaोsa men sabase achchhi birayani ki dukana ki kalpana karen।

articles.title: Chhattisgarh teachers get lucrative posting with fake orders
articles.summary: RAIPUR: In Chhattisgarh’s School Education Department, apparent bureaucratic negligence and forgery expose how astonishingly easy it is to hoodwink the state apparatus. From counterfeit transfer lists carrying forged seals of the Secretariat to fabricated earlier public circulars declaring extended school holidays, bogus official orders are not merely circulating—they are slipping through official scrutiny and ironically being enforced on the ground.

articles.summary_hi: रायपुर: छत्तीसगढ़ के स्कूल शिक्षा विभाग में, स्पष्ट नौकरशाही लापरवाही और जालसाजी यह उजागर करती है कि राज्य तंत्र को चकमा देना कितना आसान है। सचिवालय की जाली मुहरों वाली नकली स्थानांतरण सूचियों से लेकर विस्तारित स्कूल छुट्टियों की घोषणा करने वाले मनगढ़ंत पूर्व सार्वजनिक परिपत्रों तक, फर्जी आधिकारिक आदेश न केवल प्रसारित हो रहे हैं - वे आधिकारिक जांच के माध्यम से फिसल रहे हैं और विडंबना यह है कि उन्हें जमीन पर लागू किया जा रहा है।
articles.title_hinglish: pharji aadesha se chhattisagadha ke shikshakon ko milati hai aakarshaka posting!
articles.summary_hinglish: rayapur: chhattisagadha ke skula shiksha vibhaga men, spashta naukarashahi laparavahi aura jalasaji yaha ujagara karati hai ki rajya tantra ko chakama dena kitana aasana hai। sachivalaya ki jali muharon vali nakali sthanantarana suchiyon se lekara vistarita skula chhuttiyon ki ghoshana karane vale managadhanta purva sarvajanika paripatron tak, pharji aadhikarika aadesha na kevala prasarita ho rahe hain - ve aadhikarika jancha ke madhyama se phisala rahe hain aura vidanbana yaha hai ki unhen jamina para lagu kiya ja raha hai।

articles.title: Two held for attack on J&K-bound bus in Haryana
articles.summary: CHANDIGARH/SRINAGAR: Two men were rounded up for allegedly pelting a Srinagar-bound luxury bus with stones following a dispute in Haryana’s Karnal on Saturday night, injuring several Kashmiri passengers on board. The incident occurred around 11. 30 pm on Saturday at the parking area of the Divine Star dhaba in Karnal.

articles.summary_hi: चंडीगढ़/श्रीनगर: शनिवार रात हरियाणा के करनाल में एक विवाद के बाद श्रीनगर जा रही एक लग्जरी बस पर कथित तौर पर पथराव करने के आरोप में दो लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया गया है, जिससे उसमें सवार कई कश्मीरी यात्री घायल हो गए। घटना शनिवार रात करीब 11.30 बजे करनाल के डिवाइन स्टार ढाबे के पार्किंग एरिया में हुई.

articles.title: Odisha CM Mohan Majhi takes on Naveen Patnaik over 8-year freeze on campus polls
articles.summary: Addressing the Young Leaders' Conclave in Cuttack, Majhi said the recent elections in colleges and universities were conducted without violence. He also outlined his government's initiatives for students, including free education and plans to build new hostels. articles.summary_hi: मध्य प्रदेश में अगले तीन दिनों में मौसम में बदलाव की संभावना है। भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (आईएमडी) ने दशहरा के दिन 20 अक्टूबर को इंदौर, उज्जैन, भोपाल और नर्मदापुरम संभाग के 14 जिलों के लिए आंधी और बारिश का अलर्ट जारी किया है। हवाएं 30-40 किमी प्रति घंटे की रफ्तार तक पहुंच सकती हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: dashahara para indaura aura ujjaina men barisha ka anuman: emapi sameta 15 jilon men alarta
articles.summary_hinglish: madhya pradesha men agale tina dinon men mausama men badalava ki sanbhavana hai। bharata mausama vijnyana vibhaga (aaeeemadi) ne dashahara ke dina 20 aktubara ko indaur, ujjain, bhopala aura narmadapurama sanbhaga ke 14 jilon ke lie aandhi aura barisha ka alarta jari kiya hai। havaen 30-40 kimi prati ghante ki raphtara taka pahuncha sakati hain।

articles.title: Rajasthan temperatures drop below 20°C in over 10 cities: Clear weather likely for four
articles.summary: Rain lashed several districts of Rajasthan, including Jaipur, Sawai Madhopur, Tonk and Ajmer, on Sunday under the influence of a western disturbance, with hail reported in some places, while cloudy skies prevailed in parts of Jodhpur and Nagaur. The weather system reduced sunshine throughout Sunday, keeping temperatures below normal and bringing a slight chill during both the day and night.

articles.summary_hi: पश्चिमी विक्षोभ के प्रभाव के कारण रविवार को जयपुर, सवाई माधोपुर, टोंक और अजमेर सहित राजस्थान के कई जिलों में बारिश हुई, कुछ स्थानों पर ओलावृष्टि हुई, जबकि जोधपुर और नागौर के कुछ हिस्सों में बादल छाए रहे। मौसम प्रणाली के कारण रविवार को पूरे दिन धूप कम रही, जिससे तापमान सामान्य से नीचे रहा और दिन और रात दोनों में हल्की ठंड रही।
articles.title_hinglish: rajasthana ke 10 se adhika shaharon men tapamana 20 digri selsiyasa se niche chala gay: chara shaharon men mausama sapha rahane ki sanbhavana hai

articles.title: Older faces proved more successful than newcomers in UP: Replacing 40% of MLAs could
articles.summary: Follow Bhaskar English for latest updates on UP BJP election strategy and potential rebellion. To secure a third consecutive victory in 2027 and address public resentment, the BJP is preparing to bet on new faces. There have been repeated indications that the BJP may adopt the pattern followed in Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Haryana and Assam in Uttar Pradesh.
articles.title_hi: यूपी में नए चेहरों की तुलना में पुराने चेहरे अधिक सफल साबित हुए: 40% विधायकों को बदला जा सका
articles.summary_hi: यूपी बीजेपी की चुनावी रणनीति और संभावित बगावत पर ताजा अपडेट के लिए भास्कर इंग्लिश को फॉलो करें। 2027 में लगातार तीसरी जीत हासिल करने और जनता की नाराजगी दूर करने के लिए बीजेपी नए चेहरों पर दांव लगाने की तैयारी कर रही है। बार-बार ऐसे संकेत मिल रहे हैं कि बीजेपी गुजरात, मध्य प्रदेश, हरियाणा और असम का पैटर्न उत्तर प्रदेश में भी अपना सकती है.
articles.title_hinglish: yupi men nae cheharon ki tulana men purane chehare adhika saphala sabita hue: 40% vidhayakon ko badala ja saka
articles.summary_hinglish: yupi bijepi ki chunavi rananiti aura sanbhavita bagavata para taja apadeta ke lie bhaskara inglisha ko pholo karen। 2027 men lagatara tisari jita hasila karane aura janata ki narajagi dura karane ke lie bijepi nae cheharon para danva lagane ki taiyari kara rahi hai। bara-bara aise sanketa mila rahe hain ki bijepi gujarat, madhya pradesh, hariyana aura asama ka paitarna uttara pradesha men bhi apana sakati hai.

articles.title: India’s Finance Minister blames easy exits and excess liquidity for equity market's
articles.summary: Excess liquidity in India's equity market has contributed to underperformance and may continue to do so, according to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. "Because of the ease of liquidity, ease of availability, people are even exiting easily" from equities, Sitharaman told CNBC in an exclusive interview on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok on Friday.

articles.title: India’s Birds In The Dark wins big at Busan International Film Festival
articles.summary: In a major moment for independent cinema in India, Shashank Walia’s Birds in the Dark (Hanere De Panchi) has won multiple honours at Busan. Winning the prestigious New Currents Award and the Songwon Vision Audience Award at the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF), the film has received prize money totalling 30 million South Korean won.
articles.title_hi: बुसान इंटरनेशनल फिल्म फेस्टिवल में इंडियाज बर्ड्स इन द डार्क ने बड़ी जीत हासिल की

articles.title_hinglish: busana intaraneshanala philma phestivala men indiyaja bardsa ina da darka ne badaी jita hasila ki
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata men svatantra sinema ke lie eka pramukha kshana men, shashanka valiya ki bardsa ina da darka (hanere de panchhi) ne busana men kaee sammana jite hain। 31ven busana intaraneshanala philma phestivala (biaaeeephaepha) men pratishthita nyu karantsa avorda aura songavona vijana ऑdiyansa avorda jitakar, philma ko kula 30 miliyana dakshina koriyaee puraskara rashi mili hai।

articles.title: National Unity Day: Motorcycle rally flagged off to spread anti-drug message
articles.summary: Throughout the route, the motorcyclists will make scheduled stops at schools, colleges and public places to directly interact with youth and community members. Farooqui stated that carrying educational and motivational material, the riders will deliver lectures and conduct awareness sessions to sensitise the masses to say no to drugs and choose a healthy lifestyle.
articles.title_hi: राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस: नशा विरोधी संदेश फैलाने के लिए मोटरसाइकिल रैली को दिखाई हरी झंडी
articles.summary_hi: पूरे मार्ग में, मोटरसाइकिल चालक युवाओं और समुदाय के सदस्यों के साथ सीधे बातचीत करने के लिए स्कूलों, कॉलेजों और सार्वजनिक स्थानों पर रुकेंगे। फारूकी ने कहा कि शैक्षिक और प्रेरक सामग्री लेकर, राइडर्स व्याख्यान देंगे और जागरूकता सत्र आयोजित करेंगे ताकि जनता को नशीली दवाओं को न कहने और स्वस्थ जीवन शैली चुनने के लिए जागरूक किया जा सके।
articles.title_hinglish: rashtriya ekata divas: nasha virodhi sandesha phailane ke lie motarasaikila raili ko dikhaee hari jhandi

articles.title: Tiger Shroff's hand burnt with gunpowder, Eknath Shinde vows action against gangs
articles.summary: Shinde described the incident as serious and vowed strict action against those responsible, warning that no gang or individual would be allowed to revive gang wars in Mumbai. Shinde said five rounds were fired at Tiger Shroff 's BMW as the actor was leaving after playing a football match on Sunday evening.
articles.title_hi: टाइगर श्रॉफ का हाथ बारूद से जला, एकनाथ शिंदे ने गिरोह के खिलाफ कार्रवाई की कसम खाई

articles.title_hinglish: taigara shropha ka hatha baruda se jal, ekanatha shinde ne giroha ke khilapha karravaee ki kasama khaee

articles.title: Gujarat: Contractor booked as 6-year-old bridge found unsafe in Narmada district
articles.summary: The Roads and Buildings Department filed the complaint against Surat-based Royal Infra Engineering Pvt Ltd at Rajpipla police station following directions from Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel, a government release said. The bridge, located on the Rajpipla-Ramgadh (Navagam) road, was constructed at a cost of Rs 10. 71 crore. The department awarded the contract to the firm in 2018-19.
articles.title_hi: गुजरात: नर्मदा जिले में 6 साल पुराना पुल असुरक्षित पाए जाने पर ठेकेदार पर मामला दर्ज किया गया
articles.summary_hi: एक सरकारी विज्ञप्ति में कहा गया है कि सड़क और भवन विभाग ने मुख्यमंत्री भूपेन्द्र पटेल के निर्देश के बाद सूरत स्थित रॉयल इंफ्रा इंजीनियरिंग प्राइवेट लिमिटेड के खिलाफ राजपीपला पुलिस स्टेशन में शिकायत दर्ज की है। राजपीपला-रामगढ़ (नवागाम) रोड पर स्थित इस पुल का निर्माण 10. 71 करोड़ रुपये की लागत से किया गया था। विभाग ने 2018-19 में फर्म को ठेका दे दिया।

articles.title: Release pending incentives to medal-winning athletes: Anurag Thakur to Himachal govt
articles.summary: Expressing concern over the state's sports infrastructure, Thakur said despite availability of resources, several areas still lack essential facilities such as indoor stadiums, synthetic tracks and other sports infrastructure. He called upon the state government to address the shortage of playgrounds and ensure appointment of trained coaches across different sports disciplines.
articles.title_hi: पदक विजेता एथलीटों को लंबित प्रोत्साहन राशि जारी करें: अनुराग ठाकुर ने हिमाचल सरकार से कहा
articles.summary_hi: राज्य के खेल बुनियादी ढांचे पर चिंता व्यक्त करते हुए, ठाकुर ने कहा कि संसाधनों की उपलब्धता के बावजूद, कई क्षेत्रों में अभी भी इनडोर स्टेडियम, सिंथेटिक ट्रैक और अन्य खेल बुनियादी ढांचे जैसी आवश्यक सुविधाओं का अभाव है। उन्होंने राज्य सरकार से खेल के मैदानों की कमी को दूर करने और विभिन्न खेल विषयों में प्रशिक्षित प्रशिक्षकों की नियुक्ति सुनिश्चित करने का आह्वान किया।

articles.title: Bihars vanishing Ramleela tradition: Village stages silent as Dussehra celebrations change
articles.summary: AURANGABAD (Bihar), Oct 18 : Once upon a time, as Dussehra approached, villages across Bihar would begin preparing for one of their most cherished cultural traditions Ramleela. Months before the festival, local committees would become active, performers would begin rehearsals and villages (chowraha) squares would gradually turn into open-air theatres where episodes from the Ramayana came alive before enthusiastic audiences.
articles.title_hi: बिहार की लुप्त हो रही रामलीला परंपरा: दशहरा समारोह में बदलाव के साथ गांव के मंचों पर सन्नाटा
articles.summary_hi: औरंगाबाद (बिहार), 18 अक्टूबर: एक समय था, जब दशहरा नजदीक आता था, बिहार भर के गांव अपनी सबसे प्रतिष्ठित सांस्कृतिक परंपराओं में से एक रामलीला की तैयारी शुरू कर देते थे। त्योहार से महीनों पहले, स्थानीय समितियाँ सक्रिय हो जाती थीं, कलाकार रिहर्सल शुरू कर देते थे और गाँव (चौराहा) के चौराहे धीरे-धीरे ओपन-एयर थिएटर में बदल जाते थे जहाँ उत्साही दर्शकों के सामने रामायण के एपिसोड जीवंत हो जाते थे।
articles.title_hinglish: bihara ki lupta ho rahi ramalila paranpar: dashahara samaroha men badalava ke satha ganva ke manchon para sannata
articles.summary_hinglish: aurangabada (bihara), 18 aktubar: eka samaya th, jaba dashahara najadika aata th, bihara bhara ke ganva apani sabase pratishthita sanskritika paranparaon men se eka ramalila ki taiyari shuru kara dete the। tyohara se mahinon pahale, sthaniya samitiyan sakriya ho jati thin, kalakara riharsala shuru kara dete the aura ganva (chauraha) ke chaurahe dhire-dhire opana-eyara thietara men badala jate the jahan utsahi darshakon ke samane ramayana ke episoda jivanta ho jate the।

articles.title: Jammu and Kashmir leaders condemn violent attack on bus in Haryana
articles.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir government and various political parties have unitedly condemned a violent attack on a Srinagar-bound bus in Haryana. Officials are demanding strict action against those responsible for the incident. This condemnation highlights growing concerns over passenger safety during interstate travel, prompting calls for enhanced security measures to protect travelers from similar threats in the future.
articles.title_hi: जम्मू-कश्मीर के नेताओं ने हरियाणा में बस पर हिंसक हमले की निंदा की
articles.summary_hi: जम्मू-कश्मीर सरकार और विभिन्न राजनीतिक दलों ने एकजुट होकर हरियाणा में श्रीनगर जा रही बस पर हिंसक हमले की निंदा की है। अधिकारी घटना के लिए जिम्मेदार लोगों के खिलाफ सख्त कार्रवाई की मांग कर रहे हैं. यह निंदा अंतरराज्यीय यात्रा के दौरान यात्री सुरक्षा पर बढ़ती चिंताओं को उजागर करती है, जिससे भविष्य में यात्रियों को इसी तरह के खतरों से बचाने के लिए सुरक्षा उपायों को बढ़ाने की मांग की जाती है।
articles.title_hinglish: jammu-kashmira ke netaon ne hariyana men basa para hinsaka hamale ki ninda ki
articles.summary_hinglish: jammu-kashmira sarakara aura vibhinna rajanitika dalon ne ekajuta hokara hariyana men shrinagara ja rahi basa para hinsaka hamale ki ninda ki hai। adhikari ghatana ke lie jimmedara logon ke khilapha sakhta karravaee ki manga kara rahe hain. yaha ninda antararajyiya yatra ke daurana yatri suraksha para badhati chintaon ko ujagara karati hai, jisase bhavishya men yatriyon ko isi taraha ke khataron se bachane ke lie suraksha upayon ko badhaाne ki manga ki jati hai।

articles.title: Mumbai Crime Branch files closure report in slum redevelopment fraud case
articles.summary: The city crime branch has submitted a closure report regarding an alleged one thousand crore rupee financial fraud tied to a Slum Rehabilitation Authority project in Jogeshwari East. The investigation involved a major redevelopment initiative at Shankarwadi.
